title: The Compass, The Caves, and The Buffalo
summary: In a forgotten study, Emmet, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, deciphers jumbled grunts from a bookshelf. Distant twisters arch, hinting at a coming revolution. She finds an esoteric device, a pyrrhic tool that points to a lost world. Navigating a ramshackle barouche, she senses an ambush in viridescent caves. A gnomic mentor's echoes guide her. Now, a colossal buffalo stands on a djebel, a testament to her journey. The empathic impact of her actions reverberates, changing the vapory landscape forever. Her purpose, once undefined, has finally come into focus.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
